claims.head: A shadow job for Mikheyev, Girgensons and Holmberg
claims.call: The Lightning’s L4 (Mikheyev, Girgensons and Holmberg) spends at least 41% of its 5-on-5 time against the Jets’ first line.
claims.body: At home, the Lightning keep sending Mikheyev’s line (Mikheyev, Girgensons and Holmberg) out against opponents’ first lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Jon Cooper has been using this group as a checking line on the other team’s top line. Tonight the Jets’ first line is Connor, Scheifele and Perfetti.
claims.nums: At home: 41% of this group’s 5-on-5 time against first lines, about 31% with no line matching
claims.gist: At home, Jon Cooper likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Jets’ first line.

claims.head: Skinner is due against the Lightning
claims.body: Skinner has been shaky against the Lightning since 2023-24, well below his usual. But three seasons of data say a goalie’s record against one team tells us nothing about the next meeting, so don’t be surprised if he looks like himself tonight.
claims.nums: 5 starts against Tampa Bay: .852 save percentage · .900 against everyone else
claims.gist: Don’t read much into Skinner’s record against the Lightning.
claims.call: If Skinner starts, his save percentage lands closer to his usual .900 than to his .852 against the Lightning.

claims.head: The Lightning hunt better looks than the Jets
claims.body: The Lightning wait for good looks, but the Jets settle for hopeful ones. Tampa Bay is one of the league’s best for shot quality, and Winnipeg is one of the worst. The more dangerous chances should be the Lightning’s.

notes.text: Josh Morrissey is on injured reserve (upper body injury) and has missed the last 6 games. He is a top-four defenseman. Mario Ferraro has taken his spot beside Dylan DeMelo.
Brayden Yager was added to the roster on Oct 20 and has played beside Adam Lowry and Isak Rosén.
Jack St. Ivany is no longer killing penalties: 0% of the team’s shorthanded time in 4 games, down from 35% with his old team last season.

They dressed 11 forwards and 7 defensemen in 9 of their last 10 games, including the last one. Gage Goncalves takes shifts on two lines, L1 and L3. Victor Hedman is the seventh defenseman, rotating in mostly beside Crozier and Černák.
Yanni Gourde is on the injured non-roster list (hip surgery) and has not played this season. Ilya Mikheyev has taken his spot beside Zemgus Girgensons and Pontus Holmberg.
Max Crozier returned in their last game after missing 2 games.
John Carlson is no longer killing penalties: 0% of the team’s shorthanded time in 10 games, down from 47% with his old team last season.
Emil Lilleberg is no longer killing penalties: 4% of the team’s shorthanded time in 4 games, down from 32% last season.

faceoff.text: Anthony Cirelli is sent out to take power-play faceoffs, then changes. He has taken 51% of the team’s power-play draws but stays on for about 25 seconds at a time, against 66 for the regulars, and is most often replaced by Brandon Hagel (17 of 24 changes).

TBL.head: The Lightning should be in control
TBL.body: Tampa Bay has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and has home-ice advantage, while Winnipeg will be without Morrissey. If the Jets want to spoil it, start with a penalty kill that holds up.

WPG.head: A steep climb for the Jets
WPG.body: Tampa Bay has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and has home-ice advantage, while Winnipeg will be without Morrissey. The Jets can still win it if their penalty kill holds up, but a lot has to go their way.

paras: The Lightning are 7-3-0. The Jets are winless in four (0-2-2).
